Teekhi dhaar dushman aur dost dono ko kaat ti hai.
Sach hazaron chalak mukhauton ke peeche chhipa hai.
Teekhi jeebh do-dhaari talwar hai.
Chatur lomdi apni hi poochh se pakdi jaaye.
Tez dimaag devtaon ka sabse accha tohfa hai.
Dimaag shaant vichar mein apna langar daalta hai.
Dil ek aisa kila hai jise todna mushkil hai.
Buddhi bhaari bojh ko halka kar deti hai.
Man vichaaron se rangaa hai.
Darpan tab tak jhooth bole jab tak aatma shuddh na ho.
Junoon banaye hue pul ko jala deta hai.
Ek khushnuma geet adharat toofaan ko chunauti deta hai.
Teekhi baat buddhi ki talwar hai.
Chalak dhokebaaz moorkhon ka mukut pehenta hai.
Ek chalak dhokha sadgun ka chola pehenta hai.
Ek teekha jawab ek sena ke barabar hota hai.
Man hi insaan ka maap hai.
Log un satyo par thokar khate hain jo jhooth hona chahte hain.
Hosh arajakta ke sath ek nazuk samjhauta hai.
Pahad ko suno, hawa ko nahi.
Teekha dimaag dhokhe ko lohe ki tarah kaat deta hai.
Ek chatur chaal gardan ko rassi se bachati hai.
Aatma ki apni tarkshakti hai.
Hum moorkhata ke baadh ke khilaf buddhi ki naav banate hain.
Khwahish insaan ko anjaane samandar paar karwa deti hai.
Sabse gehre paani shant chalte hain, jaise chalak sadyantra.
Bharosa ek baar banta hai aur hamesha ke liye kho jaata hai.
Lalach ek atal pyaala hai.
Jala hua bachcha aag se darta hai.
Jo khud ki seva kare, uska maalik bura hota hai.
Ek prasann baat sabse andhere hisse ko roshan karti hai.
Saral jeevan dhanwaan jeevan hai.
Shabd beej hain; dhyan se bo-o.
Dhiraj kadvi jad ko meetha kare.
Aane wala kal aaj ka vidyarthi hai.
Gyaan andhe ki aankh hai.
Buddhi gusse wale devtaon ka krodh shaant karti hai.
Ek chalak mazak ghamandi samrat ko jhuka deta hai.
Buddhi tark ke galiyaaron mein roshni hai.
Samajhdar naavik shak ki fusfusahat sunta hai.
Buddhi dimaag mein khilne wala phool hai.
Ek chalak mazak zakhi rooh ko theek karta hai.
Ek chatur jawabi hamla dimaag ka dwand hai.
Hansi un zakhmon ko bharti hai jahan loha nahi pahunchta.
Har phool ko gandagi se ugna padta hai.
Insaani bhulbhulaiya ka koi exit nahi, bas gehraai hai.
Teekhi buddhi teekhi talwar se behtar hai.
Tez buddhi anjaane khatron par jeet paati hai.
